note: The operations an agent may run in Unity, and whether each one needs a real graphics device. Invoke-UnityBackground.ps1 reads this file to choose the mode in -Auto, and UnityLauncherRegistryTests checks it against the editor assembly, so a new entry point cannot silently fall back to the wrong mode. An operation marked requiresGraphics runs with -batchmode and without -nographics and must write its evidence to a file.

operations.name: EditModeTests
operations.description: The Edit Mode suite: data, prefabs, configuration and generators.

operations.name: PlayModeTests
operations.description: The Play Mode suite: battle logic, AI, telemetry and simulations.

operations.name: BuildCombatAssets
operations.description: Rebuild the combat prefabs, including their hull colliders.

operations.name: BuildTestRange
operations.description: Rebuild the test range scene and its prototype assets.

operations.name: BuildNavigationRange
operations.description: Rebuild the navigation range scene.

operations.name: MoveBattleScenesIntoMapsAndLabs
operations.description: Apply the scene layout: move the battle scenes into Maps and Labs, repoint the build settings and the project template, and remove the unused sample scene.

operations.name: BuildRiverCrossingMap
operations.description: Rebuild the River Crossing map, its scenes and its rules from the map source.

operations.name: BuildWotMapScene
operations.description: Rebuild the Mines battle scene from the converted WoT arena.

operations.name: BuildWotMapTacticalAnalysis
operations.description: Rebuild the tactical descriptor of the Mines arena.

operations.name: ImportWotMap
operations.description: Reimport the converted Mines arena asset.

operations.name: BuildCombatVfxAssets
operations.description: Draw the combat effect textures and build their materials and prefabs from the profiles. It must produce the same files here as in the editor, which is why it is headless.

operations.name: ReimportCombatDefinitions
operations.description: Reimport the tank, weapon and shell definitions into generated assets.

operations.name: ReimportBattleScenario
operations.description: Reimport the battle scenario into its generated asset.

operations.name: ReimportAiDuelLabScenario
operations.description: Reimport the AI duel lab scenario into its generated asset.

operations.name: ReimportAiDuelLabCases
operations.description: Reimport the AI duel lab case catalogue from its source.

operations.name: ReimportAiSquadLabScenario
operations.description: Reimport the AI three-versus-three squad lab scenario into its generated asset.

operations.name: ReimportAiSquadLabCases
operations.description: Reimport the AI three-versus-three seed catalogue from its source.

operations.name: RebuildTacticalMapAnalysis
operations.description: Rebuild the tactical map analysis from the arena primitives, and the document that describes it.

operations.name: UpdateTankBalanceDocument
operations.description: Regenerate the tank balance document from the combat definitions.

operations.name: ValidateCombatDefinitions
operations.description: Validate the tank, weapon and shell definitions; throws with every problem it finds.

operations.name: ValidateBattleScenario
operations.description: Validate the battle scenario against the definitions.

operations.name: ValidateTacticalMapAnalysis
operations.description: Validate the tactical map analysis against its source.

operations.name: ValidateCombatVfxProfiles
operations.description: Validate the combat effect profiles.

operations.name: ValidateCombatVfxAssets
operations.description: Validate that the generated effect assets match the effect list.

operations.name: ValidateBattleAudioProfiles
operations.description: Validate the battle audio profile against the clip catalogue.

operations.name: InspectCombatVfxSprites
operations.description: Report the imported format and pixels of every generated effect texture. It reads pixel data on the CPU, so it never needs a graphics device.

operations.name: CaptureSettingsPanel
operations.description: Render the settings overlay at a normal and a short window size and write the pictures. UI Toolkit paints into a panel texture instead of going through a camera and needs frames to do it, so the capture runs as a Play Mode test with a real graphics device; the headless suite ignores it.

operations.name: CaptureBattleHudProof
operations.description: Render the real River Crossing battle HUD with numeric HP, weapon state, an applied-damage popup and a spotted enemy beyond the camera edge.

operations.name: CaptureAimProof
operations.description: Render the real hull outline component for an ally and an enemy together with penetration-chance colours from the combat reticle.

operations.name: RenderCombatVfxProof
operations.description: Render every combat effect and print pattern into one sheet at the moment it covers the most of the frame. A null graphics device discards every draw call, so this is the only way to see what the effect library looks like.

operations.name: RenderCombatVfxBattleProof
operations.description: Render the effects on real machines at battle scale, which is the only way to judge their size against a hull.

operations.name: CaptureTrackEffectPreview
operations.description: Render the tank tread overlay at four zoom levels and two phases, with the overlay off for comparison.

operations.name: CaptureRiverCrossingPreview
operations.description: Render the River Crossing map from the battle camera.

operations.name: CaptureWotMapPreview
operations.description: Render the Mines arena from above so the ground surface and the navigation wash can be judged from the image rather than from scene data.

operations.name: CaptureWotGroundDetailPreview
operations.description: Render the Mines ground alone at camera zooms 4, 8 and 12. The whole-map preview cannot reveal an undersized imported texture, so these close views are the sharpness proof.
